responsibility: Implements a scanner-oriented input source on top of FIO that can read characters from a file while also supporting an explicit pushback stack, tracking current file name, line, and column, and issuing source-positioned errors or warnings. It normalizes CR/LF handling, allows strings or DynamicStrings values to be unread in reverse, and maintains an accumulated exit status for warning-only runs, making it the core reversible character stream used by simple lexical consumers rather than a generic file layer.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the GPushBackInput pair: it defines the pushback stack, current file/line/column tracking, CR/LF normalization, debug echoing, and diagnostic emission behavior, whereas GPushBackInput.h only declares the scanner-style input operations.
